question: Can retracting vendor workflow/cognitive narrative from genuinely changed thinking-tool descriptions, while preserving source-grounded operation facts and parameter text, improve original-task completion and product quality?
answer: This frozen version did not pass development. Close instruction_scope v1 and its ineligible quote control; no validation or favorable resampling.
decision_scope: 15 exposed original cells, one repeat per condition/arm. A negative version result, not a population-level causal exclusion of static representation, LLM adaptation, deletion or tool-description effects.

facts: Main and SP project normal/core are both 0/2; full changed completion 2/4 to 1/4 and core 0/4 to 0/4. Project TF 9.4 to 9.6; full TF 9.4 to 9.25. Retention TF 10 to 9.4, normal 1/1 both, primary core 0/1 both.

All six project runs lack complete final handover: five empty finals with max_rounds, one quote-control partial final with output_truncated. All six persisted projects and tasks; five graphs have assessable bounded leaves, while the flat parsed PRD has insufficient individual detail and unfinished refinement.
One main Late project lowered complexity/names without actual decomposition on three leaves; a separate component-library split did save a genuine additional task. This mixed behavior is retained.

All 133 and235 effective knowledge is exactly SP in all arms. Therefore differences on these tasks cannot be attributed to the tested knowledge edits; they remain part of frozen admission gates.

five_category_review.finding: Changed operational-description records alone did not produce a successful project handover. No thinking calls occurred, but that does not show descriptions had no contextual effect.

five_category_review.level: direct stopping evidence; root cause unknown
five_category_review.finding: Five project runs hit12rounds; the sixth and two mathematical runs ended at4096 completion tokens. Stops establish exhaustion/truncation; causal source of allocation is not identified.

Project handover absent/incomplete; six mathematical cores fail because of unestablished delivery or incorrect validation/code consistency. R05/R07 magnitude bypass, R12 allowed-function-name rejection and R11 incomplete code are visible/static defects; no generated code executed.
All frozen original inputs ran; no missing-input377 route reopened and no synthetic substitution. Native method/validation errors are retained, not automatically equated with task failure.

Official TF remains9.0–9.8 for five empty project finals. R13/R14 retention prose and R10 task-scope sensitivity are pre-unblinding alternatives; permissive overrides still fail promotion. Same coordinator reviewed opaque IDs, not an independent human; same exposed families and no formal validation.

causal_limits: Primary source factoring plus narrative retraction versus SP is a bundle; quote control shares facts but is not length-matched. Single repeat cannot separate instruction authority, length, provider variation, scheduling or construction capacity.
Primary project TF rises by0.2 while calls rise137to160 and completion/core stayzero; this is an observed local metric difference, not reliable benefit or identified cause.
The quote-control batch adoption is a new observation on an already-known bulk tool, not evidence that batching caused success or that the control may replace the nominated candidate.
Identical-knowledge math/retention variability is evidence against attributing all aggregate changes to the adaptation, but does not waive the frozen non-regression gates.

next_decision.closed: No same-version rerun, no promotion of quote control, no changes to acceptance or actor budgets.
next_decision.remaining_unknown: Whether task-free tool-knowledge decisions can reliably change product construction and handover under fixed actor. LLM involvement as such is not a tested mechanism distinction.
next_decision.admission_for_next: A future candidate needs a distinct decision/representation mechanism and predecessor check; a native/proxy success is not required unless that mechanism actually depends on a correct positive example. No new candidate or new model experiment is frozen by this closing report.
next_decision.priority: Product construction/handover and fixed-budget allocation remain the two observed bottlenecks; do not select another metadata wording tweak solely because this version failed.
